changelog:
Initial release of Padel Americano skill.

- Create and manage Padel Americano tournament sessions with fair-shuffled rotations.
- Register players, courts, set rounds and points per game; generate fixed or open-ended events.
- Record scores, add/remove/switch/pause players mid-session, and regenerate future rounds as needed.
- Compute official and alternative leaderboards (by points, wins, percentages).
- Export schedules, scores, and statistics to PDF.
